title: hip2~
body:
[hip2~] is a 1st order highpass filter (1-pole, 1-zero) like [hip~], but with a more accurate frequency response, especially at higher frequencies, and support for multichannel signals.

The filter outputs the same number of channels as the left input. If the right input has more than one channel, the number of channels must match. A single channel gets repeated to match the channels of the left input.
